Load-test command parsing, topology setup, and single-process execution for an external validator.

# Purpose
This file implements the `load` action for a command-line control tool. It parses load-test options such as `--tpu-ip`, `--rpc-ip`, `--tpu-port`, `--rpc-port`, `--num-benchg`, `--num-benchs`, `--num-accounts`, `--connections`, `--transaction-mode`, `--contending-fraction`, `--cu-price-spread`, `--affinity`, and `--no-quic`. It also defines the `fd_action_load` descriptor, which exposes the action name, argument parser, permission check, execution function, and description for the command framework.

The execution path in [`load_cmd_fn`](<#load_cmd_fn>) fills in default values from `config_t` when the user does not supply them, builds a topology with `fd_topob_new`, adds benchmark tiles with `add_bench_topo`, and then runs the configured topology with `fd_topo_run_single_process`. Before the run starts, it calls `configure_cmd_fn` to prepare the system, initializes workspaces and stacks, and prints the final runtime settings. The file also contains `load_cmd_perm`, which reuses the configure permission logic and selects the `hugetlbfs` stage for this action.
